title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Fee Schedule: Annual Registration Fee, Meal-Status Waiver and Household Cap
content:
The Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program charges an annual registration fee for each enrolled child.

**Posting.** The registration fee posts at the per-child registration fee on the registration date of every new registration, once per enrollment per school year.

**Nonrefundable.** The fee is nonrefundable once posted. It is never credited because of a withdrawal, a waitlist release, a dismissal or the end of the program.

**Credits.** Two credits may offset the fee on the day it posts, and no other credit reason applies to it:

- **Meal-status waiver.** When the plan waives the registration fee for Free Meal Status and the student's School Nutrition meal account holds any Free Meal Status tier on the registration date, the full fee is credited as a registration-fee meal waiver. A Reduced-Price Meal Status does not waive the fee.
- **Household cap.** Otherwise, the cap compares two amounts: (a) the registration fees already charged to the household's other enrollments of the same school year that were registered earlier, net of their meal-waiver and household-cap credits, plus this fee; and (b) the household cap. When (a) exceeds (b), the excess is credited as a registration-fee household cap credit. When it does not exceed, nothing is credited.

The household cap is computed from enrollments registered earlier. A later registration never changes a credit already posted on an earlier one.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Registration fee per child per school year | Household cap per school year | Fee waived for any Free Meal Status tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| All six Creek Kids Club plans | 40.00 | 100.00 | yes |

## Worked cap (hypothetical figures)

These figures are hypothetical: a fee of 30.00 and a cap of 75.00. A household registers three children in one school year, in this order, with no meal waiver on any of them.

| Registration | Earlier net fees | Plus this fee | Excess over the cap | Cap credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| first child | 0.00 | 30.00 | none | 0.00 |
| second child | 30.00 | 60.00 | none | 0.00 |
| third child | 60.00 | 90.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 |

Now suppose the first child had held a Free Meal Status on the registration date. That child's fee would be fully credited as a meal waiver. The earlier net fees for the third child would then be 30.00, and the third child would get no cap credit. A fourth registration later in the year would leave the third child's posted credit unchanged.
